items: The zoo is laid out like the sea chart: each animal's island where the chart has it, its own shape, the sea between them flagstone streets
Islands you haven't found yet are their biome's lake, the animal's sigil faint on the water (?zoo&all shows every island)
Every island has a little gold fence round it: animals stay on their island, and you fly over it
Each island's legend sleeps in its circle at the middle; home is just the Ent's sigil circle on a stone plaza (no treehouse or dancefloor), and at the zoo's edge the water pours off into space
The zoo is flat, and its islands sit closer together
